VALIDATION.TRIGGER_REQUIRED: Add a trigger to start the flow
VALIDATION.ACTION_REQUIRED: Add at least one action to the flow
VALIDATION.WARNINGS: The flow can be saved, but these look unfinished:
VALIDATION.INTERACTIVE_BODY_REQUIRED: the message body is empty. WhatsApp rejects an interactive message without body text, so the menu never reaches the contact.
VALIDATION.INTERACTIVE_ITEMS_REQUIRED: add at least one option with a title.
VALIDATION.INTERACTIVE_VALUE_REQUIRED: every option needs a value — it is the id WhatsApp returns and what the branch matches on.
VALIDATION.WAIT_REPLIES_REQUIRED: add at least one expected reply, otherwise there is no output to branch to.
VALIDATION.WAIT_FALLBACK_MISSING: the "No match" output is not connected and there is no timeout. Any reply outside the list ends the flow silently.
VALIDATION.WAIT_KEY_UNMATCHED: the value "{key}" does not match any option sent by the previous block.
VALIDATION.PORT_NOT_CONNECTED: the "{key}" output is not connected to anything.

HTTP_REQUEST.URL_HINT: Accepts Liquid variables. Only public http(s) hosts; internal/private addresses are blocked.

AI_CLASSIFY.PROMPT_HINT: Optional. Tell the AI what to focus on when classifying.

AI_GENERATE.KEY_HINT: The generated text is saved here.

WAIT.BUSINESS_HOURS_HINT: When on, the wait ends at the next business hour of the conversation's inbox instead of at any time of day.

WAIT_FOR_REPLY.HINT: The flow pauses here until the contact replies, then branches on their answer. Each expected reply is one output — connect each to the action it should trigger.
WAIT_FOR_REPLY.LABEL_PLACEHOLDER: Label shown on the output (e.g. Schedule a visit)
WAIT_FOR_REPLY.KEY_HINT: Must match the option's value from the previous 'Send options' block.
WAIT_FOR_REPLY.TIMEOUT_HINT: If the contact doesn't reply in time, the flow takes the 'Timed out' output. Off means it waits indefinitely.
WAIT_FOR_REPLY.OUTPUTS_HINT: Each reply becomes an output; connect each to the desired action. 'No match' and 'Timed out' have their own outputs.
WAIT_FOR_REPLY.KEY_SELECT_HINT: Taken from the options of the previous block, so the value always matches.
WAIT_FOR_REPLY.SYNC_FROM_INTERACTIVE_HINT: Rebuilds the replies from the options of the connected block.

SNOOZE.HINT: The conversation reopens automatically when the time is up.

ROUTER.HINT: Routes are evaluated top to bottom. The conversation follows the first route whose conditions match; if none match, it takes the fallback.

WEBHOOK.HINT: Any external system can start this flow with an HTTP POST to this URL. Keep it secret — the URL is the only credential. Optionally send a conversation_id (the conversation number) in the JSON body to target a conversation, and an Idempotency-Key header to avoid duplicate triggers.
